weather_report:
As night envelops Boston, the air hangs with a gentle warmth, persistent yet tender, hovering around 71 degrees. The calm of the evening is only stirred by a soft breeze whispering in from the southwest, inviting one to take a moment outdoors, perhaps under the watchful glow of streetlamps that dot the cityscape. The skies remain mostly clear, a promise of the bright day that awaits. 

Come the morrow, the sun will rise with unfettered enthusiasm, bathing the city in golden light as it pushes the temperature toward a sweltering 91 degrees. With a moderate westerly breeze at its back, it will all feel rather delightful, in a summery sort of way, though one should be prepared for the slight chance of a stray drizzle. Despite the heat, the day carries a buoyant energy, perfect for leisurely strolls along the Esplanade or perhaps exploring hidden corners of local parks, while embracing the season’s carefree spirit. Dressing in breathable fabrics will be key—think light cotton or linen, wide-brimmed hats, and sunglasses to shield from the radiant sun. So as the stars fade into dawn, be ready to greet the day with an open heart and a desire for simple pleasures, from sipping iced coffee in quaint cafes to leisurely walks under the ever-deepening blue sky.
